title: My 2 recurring “mall worlds”
content: So weirdly enough, neither of mine are malls. One is a beach house that has an apartment complex on top of it. The surrounding area is a big metropolitan city My second one is the one that I see almost every night. It is a BIG boat, somewhere between a large speedboat and a cruise ship, but it goes insanely fast. Like light rail speed, and it feels like I’m time traveling. The boat is most intriguing to me, anyone else time traveling on a mega-speedboat every night?
